Youth Face Cream Ingredients: Kojic Acid & Alpha Arbutin

A simple, Youth Face-branded guide to the verified ingredients discussed in Youth Face Beauty Cream.

Youth Face Beauty Cream packaging identifies Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin. These are the only verified ingredients covered in this guide. For the complete ingredient list, directions and precautions, please check the product packaging before use.

What Are the Ingredients in Youth Face Cream?

The verified Youth Face Cream ingredients discussed here are Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin. Both are commonly used in skincare routines that focus on the appearance of uneven-looking tone and visible dark spots. Results vary, so use Youth Face Beauty Cream as directed and keep expectations realistic.

The complete ingredient list is not verified for this guide. Always consult the Youth Face Beauty Cream packaging for the full list of ingredients, directions and precautions before use.

Verified Ingredients

Youth Face Beauty Cream packaging identifies Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin. This page covers only those verified ingredients. For general educational information, read the general Kojic Acid and Alpha Arbutin skincare guide.

Use Youth Face Beauty Cream on clean, dry skin according to the product packaging. Read and follow the packaging directions before use.
